title: Silhouette Showdown
intro: [excited] Lights down, everybody! Tonight is Silhouette Showdown, where everything is a shadow, a skyline or a mystery shape. [whispers] If you see something move in the dark, it's probably just Dr. Facilier. [laughs] Probably.

art.prompt: A dramatic sunset sky in orange and purple with the black silhouettes of fairy-tale spires, a geodesic sphere, a giant carved tree and a jagged mountain lined up along the horizon, a single spotlight beam sweeping upward Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Prop Shadows
categories.intro: I'll show you the shadow of a famous movie object. You tell me the film. No peeking behind the curtain!

art.prompt: A white theater curtain lit from behind, casting crisp black shadow shapes of a slipper, a rose, a frying pan, a spindle and a magnifying glass Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This shadow of a single shoe left on a palace staircase at midnight belongs to which film?
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Cinderella! One glass slipper, one very determined Grand Duke, and one kingdom-wide shoe fitting. [laughs] Talk about a foot search.

media.prompt: Crisp black silhouette of a single delicate high-heeled glass slipper resting on a grand palace staircase, backlit by a huge glowing clock face at midnight, deep blue night sky Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A single flower slowly losing its petals under a glass dome. Name the movie this shadow comes from.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beauty and the Beast! [gasps] When that last petal falls, the spell is permanent. No pressure, Beast.

media.prompt: Black silhouette of a single long-stemmed rose under a tall glass bell jar on a small table, one petal falling, glowing pink-gold backlight in a dark gothic room Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A frying pan and a very, very long braid of hair hanging from a tower window. Which film?
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Tangled! Seventy feet of magic hair, and her weapon of choice is still a frying pan. Who knew?

media.prompt: Silhouette of a tall stone tower with an extremely long braid of hair cascading from the top window to the ground, a frying pan silhouette in the foreground, glowing floating lanterns in a warm sunset sky Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: The shadow of a spinning wheel's sharp spindle, glowing eerily in a tower room. Which film?
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is Sleeping Beauty! Touch the spindle, fall asleep. King Stefan burned every spinning wheel in the kingdom and still missed one. [sighs] Classic.

media.prompt: Silhouette of an old wooden spinning wheel with a long needle-sharp spindle in a dark circular tower room, an eerie green glow behind it, a winding staircase Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A magnifying glass silhouetted against the giant gears of a London clock tower. Name this 1986 mystery.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Great Mouse Detective! The finale battle inside Big Ben's gears was an early Disney use of computer animation. [chuckles] Elementary!

media.prompt: Black silhouette of a magnifying glass against enormous interlocking brass clockwork gears inside a Victorian clock tower, a giant clock face glowing behind, foggy London night Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Shadow Man and Friends
categories.intro: Shadows, shady characters and the friends on the other side. Let's step into the dark!

art.prompt: A long dark bayou alley at night with a lamppost casting dramatic shadows of tall hats and swirling smoke on a brick wall, voodoo-style candles and tarot-like blank cards scattered on a table Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Peter Pan, Wendy sews this back onto Peter after it gets loose.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is his shadow! It ran off and Wendy stitched it right back on. Mine just follows me to the snack bar.

clues.clue: In The Princess and the Frog, Dr. Facilier goes by this spooky two-word nickname.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Shadow Man! [chuckles] And his own shadow has a mind of its own. It does all the dirty work while he tips his hat.

clues.clue: Dr. Facilier's big villain song promises he has these on 'the other side.'
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is friends! Friends on the Other Side. Keith David sings it, and the shadows dance right along. [whispers] Creepy cool.

clues.clue: Mufasa tells Simba everything the light touches is their kingdom. Scar later sends him to this shadowy place.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the elephant graveyard! [gasps] Bones, fog and three hungry hyenas. Simba really should have listened to his dad.

clues.clue: In Fantasia's Night on Bald Mountain, this enormous winged demon spreads his shadow over a sleeping village.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is Chernabog! Animator Bill Tytla brought him to life. [sighs] And he is defeated by... church bells and sunrise. Every villain has a weakness.

categories.title: Skyline Spotters
categories.intro: Our Parks category is all real photos of park icons that own the skyline. [excited] Name what you see!

art.prompt: A twilight theme-park skyline: a glowing geodesic sphere, a giant tree, a tall hotel tower and a snowy mountain peak silhouetted against a gradient sky with fireworks Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This giant geodesic sphere has towered over EPCOT since the park opened in 1982. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Spaceship Earth! It's about 18 stories tall and takes you on a trip through the history of communication. [laughs] No, it is not a giant golf ball.

clues.clue: Name this 145-foot carved icon at the heart of Disney's Animal Kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Tree of Life! [gasps] Look closely and you'll find more than 300 animals carved into it. Bring snacks, it takes a while.

clues.clue: This creepy 199-foot hotel looms over Sunset Boulevard at Disney's Hollywood Studios. Name the attraction.
clues.answer: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
accept: the twilight zone tower of terror
choices: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror! The Hollywood Tower Hotel stays just under 200 feet, so it doesn't need an aircraft warning light. [whispers] Check out time is never.

clues.clue: A Yeti guards this snow-capped mountain coaster that opened at Animal Kingdom in 2006. Name it.
accept: expedition everest legend of the forbidden mountain
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Expedition Everest! The mountain is about 199 and a half feet tall, and the ride goes backwards in the dark. [laughs] The Yeti wants you to know he's very misunderstood.

clues.clue: This smoking volcano rises over the center of Tokyo DisneySea. Name it.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Mount Prometheus! It rumbles, it smokes, and it even erupts with fire. Inside, Journey to the Center of the Earth is waiting. True nerd points!

categories.title: Silhouette Safari
categories.intro: Shadowy critters on the horizon! [chuckles] Name the Disney character or duo these animal shapes belong to.

art.prompt: African savanna at golden sunset with black silhouettes of a lone acacia tree, a rocky outcrop and flocks of birds, a glowing orange sun on the horizon Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A meerkat and a warthog strolling at sunset with no worries at all. Name the duo.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Timon and Pumbaa! Hakuna Matata. It means no worries, and also no vegetables. Grubs only.

media.prompt: Black silhouettes of a small upright meerkat and a stocky warthog walking side by side along a log at sunset on an African savanna Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A crab and a round little fish silhouetted in a sunbeam under the sea. Name the duo.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sebastian and Flounder! [chuckles] A nervous court composer and a fish who is NOT a guppy. Ariel's best bodyguards.

media.prompt: Underwater scene with black silhouettes of a crab and a round tropical fish swimming together through sunbeams filtering down from the surface, coral below Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A tiny chameleon silhouetted on a tower windowsill. Name this loyal sidekick.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Pascal! Rapunzel's best friend, who changes color when he's in a mood. [laughs] Which is always.

media.prompt: Black silhouette of a small curly-tailed chameleon sitting on a stone tower windowsill, glowing lanterns floating in a warm evening sky beyond Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A rooster and a little potbellied pig silhouetted on an outrigger canoe. Name the duo.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Heihei and Pua from Moana! Pua stayed home, and Heihei stowed away in the boat. [whispers] He also tried to eat a rock.

media.prompt: Black silhouettes of a skinny rooster and a small round pig standing on the bow of a Polynesian outrigger canoe at sunset over the ocean Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A raven silhouetted atop a villain's glowing staff. Name this evil fairy's feathered spy.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is Diablo! Maleficent's goons searched sixteen years for a baby. [sighs] Diablo is the one who finally found the cottage.

media.prompt: Black silhouette of a raven perched on top of a tall twisted staff topped with a glowing green orb, a jagged dark castle and lightning in the background Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Voices in the Dark
categories.intro: Some stars you never see, you only hear. [chuckles] Name the voice behind the character, or the character behind the voice!

art.prompt: An old-fashioned recording studio in darkness, a single vintage microphone lit by a spotlight, a music stand and headphones, warm glow through a sound booth window Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Tom Hanks voices this pull-string cowboy in Toy Story.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Woody! There's a snake in his boot, and Tom Hanks has been the voice since 1995. Reach for the sky!

clues.clue: Robin Williams was the fast-talking Genie in this 1992 film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aladdin! [laughs] Robin Williams improvised so much that animators had hours of material to choose from. Phenomenal cosmic power!

clues.clue: James Earl Jones, the voice of Mufasa, also voiced this Star Wars villain.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is Darth Vader! One voice, two kings of very different kingdoms. [chuckles] Mufasa had better parenting.

clues.clue: Josh Gad voices this Frozen snowman who likes warm hugs.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Olaf! He dreams of summer, which for a snowman is a very bold choice.

clues.clue: Sterling Holloway voiced Winnie the Pooh, Kaa, and this grinning, disappearing feline from 1951.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Cheshire Cat! Sterling Holloway was also the stork in Dumbo. [chuckles] That man was the voice of my childhood.
